name: Meta Ray-Ban Display
criticsTake: Critics agree the Neural Band wristband and the bright, readable in-lens display are the standout parts, and several call these the most advanced smart glasses available. Reviewers also found the frames heavy and chunky, the app selection thin and tied to Meta's ecosystem, and battery life short. Scores run from 5/10 at The Verge to 7/10 at CNET, and most reviewers advise the cheaper display-free Ray-Ban Meta unless you want to be an early adopter.

name: Apple Watch Ultra 4
criticsTake: Critics call the Apple Watch Ultra 4 the best Apple Watch yet, led by a new Health Sensing System with continuous heart rate tracking, the Readiness score and battery life of up to 50 hours. The design, display and $799 price are unchanged, so most reviewers say Ultra 3 owners can skip it. Wired and Expert Reviews note that the cheaper Series 12 shares most of the new health features.
